_header.purpose: AArch64 NZCV producer/consumer ground truth recorded NATIVELY: each fact executes one architectural instruction between MSR NZCV and MRS NZCV in a single inline-asm block and records the result register and the resulting NZCV. Replayed against crate::nzcv, the conditional-select decoder/model and the integer-only FCMP model by tests/aarch64_nzcv_silicon_bridge.rs.
_header.encoding: a/b/result are hex strings of the FULL 64-bit register values (W-form operands carry nonzero upper halves; the architecture reads bits 31:0); nzcv and nzcv_in are 4-bit N:Z:C:V integers (N = bit 3); cond is the 4-bit condition field; result is null for CMP/TST/FCMP, which write no general register.
_header.scope: regression evidence for one host CPU over a finite boundary grid; not a proof and not a claim about other AArch64 implementations.
